ops.title: no upper bound on a wedged detached codex-ask worker
ops.description: detach.go:15-52 orphans workers to PID 1 deliberately, which is correct — it survives a Bash-tool kill. But nothing bounds a wedged worker; registerGraceS=15 only classifies for reporting and kills nothing. Observed 14-16 min old workers with dead parents. Not a fork-storm cause: one long-lived process, not a spawn loop.

ops.text: --ps/--watch reaps workers past a max age
